title: acosta resupinata subsp. degenii
intro: Acosta resupinata subsp. degenii, commonly known as De Genii's Acosta, is a plant species within the family Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems, due to its purported health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of De Genii's Acosta include iridoids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
